implementation: Trusted HTTP correlation and trace roots propagate through inbound persistence, duplicate lookup, outbox and worker runtime.

Governed worker composition persists runtime state, rehydrates trace/approval context, journals controlled effects and verifies the durable audit chain.
Dead-letter API/UI is tenant scoped, Supervisor/Admin only, metadata-only, sanitized and explicit on requeue; Operator/Approver are denied.
Aquinas console keeps approval state feedback, keyboard focus, responsive shell and populated DLQ visual evidence.
